tagline.zh: 决策时间随选项数量与复杂度上升:备选越多,选得越慢。响应时间关键处要减选项、拆步骤、突出推荐项。
tagline.en: Decision time grows with the number and complexity of choices: more alternatives, slower decisions. Cut options where response time matters, split complex tasks, and surface a recommended option.

origin.zh: 1952 年英国心理学家 William Edmund Hick 与美国心理学家 Ray Hyman 用实验考察「刺激数量与反应时的关系」,得到 Hick-Hyman 定律:选择越多,决策越慢(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX;调研 07§23)。经典量化形式为 RT = a + b·log₂(N)。
origin.en: In 1952 British psychologist William Edmund Hick and American psychologist Ray Hyman experimentally related the number of stimuli to reaction time, yielding the Hick-Hyman law: more choices, slower decisions (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX; research 07 §23). Its classic form is RT = a + b·log₂(N).

effect.zh: 每轮实验的候选目标数 N。Hick-Hyman 定律:反应时随 N 对数上升(RT = a + b·log₂(N));把 N 从 2 拉到 8,在统计表里对比同 N 的中位反应时,能直接看出「选项翻倍、决策变慢」。
effect.en: Number of candidate targets N per round. The Hick-Hyman law: reaction time rises logarithmically with N (RT = a + b·log₂(N)); sweep N from 2 to 8 and compare per-N median reaction times in the stats table.

effect.zh: 命中后到下一轮高亮出现的间隔(demo 节奏参数,非定律结论)。太短会让上一轮的决策时间混入下一轮,太长则拖垮实验节奏。
effect.en: Gap between a hit and the next highlight (demo pacing, not part of the law). Too short bleeds one round's decision into the next; too long drags the experiment.

note.zh: 演示用 performance.now() 计时与 rAF/timeout 调度,全现代浏览器可用;performance 计时精度受浏览器凑扰保护(通常 ~1ms 量化),对百毫秒级行为测量足够。
note.en: The demo times with performance.now() and schedules via rAF/timeout — all modern browsers; performance timing is quantized by browser protections (~1ms), plenty for 100ms-scale behavior.

fallback.zh: 定律不可降级,其 UI 结论有三条工程出口:关键路径收窄选项;复杂表单拆步(向导/分步);把「推荐项」视觉前置以免用户在平权列表里漂移。全都必须保留全部功能——减的是决策成本,不是能力。
fallback.en: The law cannot degrade, but its UI conclusions have three engineering exits: narrow options on critical paths, split complex flows into wizards, and surface a recommended option so users don't drift across a flat list. All capability must remain — you reduce decision cost, not function.

use.zh: 响应时间关键处(支付、抢购、紧急操作)收窄选项
use.en: Narrow options where response time is critical (checkout, flash sale, emergency actions)

use.zh: 把复杂任务拆成小步(向导式表单),逐步揭示
use.en: Split complex tasks into wizard steps that reveal progressively

use.zh: 突出推荐选项,避免用户在平权列表中淹没
use.en: Highlight a recommended option instead of a flat sea of equal choices

use.zh: 对新用户做渐进式 onboarding(Slack 案例,07§23)
use.en: Progressive onboarding for new users (the Slack case, research 07 §23)

avoid.zh: 为减而减,简化到失真(lawsofux 原文告诫:be careful not to simplify to the point of abstraction)
avoid.en: Simplifying to the point of abstraction — the Laws of UX caveat verbatim

avoid.zh: 在平权长列表上不做任何分组/推荐,把决策全推给用户
avoid.en: Flat undifferentiated long lists that dump the whole decision on the user

a11y.zh: 减少视觉选项不等于减少可达功能:被「渐进披露」藏起的功能必须仍可经键盘/读屏到达(结构见 keyboard-navigation 条目)。高亮目标不能只靠颜色区分(对比 WCAG SC 1.4.1);演示中目标同时用描边+文字标记。
a11y.en: Reducing visible options must not reduce reachable function: features hidden behind progressive disclosure stay reachable via keyboard and screen readers (structure in the keyboard-navigation entry). The highlighted target is never color-only (cf. WCAG SC 1.4.1); the demo marks it with an outline plus text.

goal.zh: 做一个选择反应时实验:N 个候选目标排成圆环,每轮随机高亮一个,测量「高亮出现→点击命中」的决策时间;按 N 分组统计中位反应时,让用户亲手验证「选项越多、决策越慢」。
goal.en: Build a choice-reaction-time experiment: N candidate targets on a ring, one randomly highlighted per round; measure highlight→hit decision time and aggregate per-N medians so the user can verify 'more choices, slower decisions' firsthand.

acceptance.zh: 候选数 N 使用参数快照值(默认 4,范围 2–8),布局随 N 实时重排
acceptance.en: Candidate count N uses the exact parameter snapshot (default 4, range 2–8) and re-layouts live

acceptance.zh: 计时从高亮出现开始、到命中结束,误点计入错误且不中断计时
acceptance.en: Timing starts when the highlight appears and stops on hit; wrong clicks count as errors without stopping the timer

acceptance.zh: 按 N 分组统计中位反应时与样本数,可跨 N 对比
acceptance.en: Per-N median reaction times with sample counts, comparable across N

acceptance.zh: 高亮目标用描边+文字双通道标记,不只靠颜色
acceptance.en: The highlighted target is marked via outline plus text, never color alone

acceptance.zh: 全部候选都是真实按钮,可键盘操作
acceptance.en: All candidates are real, keyboard-operable buttons
